entries.name: Calea Pastries & Coffee

proposal.description: A Bacolod pastry and dessert café on 15th Street offering a stop for cakes and coffee. The supplied PHP 95-1,100 menu-price range includes different products such as slices and whole cakes; it is an indicative purchase allowance, not a fixed per-person meal or admission price. Hours and branch pin are user-supplied.

entries.name: Capitol Park and Lagoon

proposal.description: A public landscape surrounding the provincial capitol lagoon, offering leafy paths and opportunities to appreciate the civic setting. The travel guide reports daily 05:00-22:00 and free ordinary entry; temporary closures and event restrictions may differ.

entries.name: Negros Forest Park

proposal.description: A conservation and wildlife education center presenting native Negros species and the work of the Talarak Foundation. Reported Tuesday-Sunday hours are 09:00-17:00; Monday is unspecified. Historical 2022 admission reports give PHP 100 for adults and PHP 50 for eligible discounted visitors; current prices are not operator-confirmed.

entries.name: Orange Project

proposal.description: A contemporary art gallery within Mandalagan’s Art District, featuring exhibitions and work by local and visiting artists. Reported exhibition admission varies: PHP 0-50 is an indicative range, not a guaranteed future tariff. The cited PHP 50 article concerns March-June 2026 exhibitions; confirm the current exhibition before visiting.

entries.name: San Sebastian Cathedral

proposal.description: A historic coral-stone Catholic cathedral in downtown Bacolod, suitable for a quiet architectural visit that respects ongoing worship. The travel guide reports these opening hours and free entry. Mass schedules are separate from sightseeing access; respect worship and any visitor restrictions.
